scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix gateway install && npm --prefix services/search install && npm --prefix services/home install && npm --prefix services/cart install && npm --prefix services/checkout install
scripts.build: npm --prefix gateway run build && npm --prefix services/search run build && npm --prefix services/home run build && npm --prefix services/cart run build && npm --prefix services/checkout run build
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n "gateway,search,home,cart,checkout" -c "blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan" "npm --prefix gateway start" "npm --prefix services/search start" "npm --prefix services/home start" "npm --prefix services/cart start" "npm --prefix services/checkout start"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "gateway,search,home,cart,checkout" -c "blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan" "npm --prefix gateway run dev" "npm --prefix services/search run dev" "npm --prefix services/home run dev" "npm --prefix services/cart run dev" "npm --prefix services/checkout run dev"
